      "project/contracts/AgriEscrow.sol": {
        "content": "// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT\r\npragma solidity ^0.8.20;\r\n\r\ncontract AgriEscrow {\r\n    enum OrderStatus {\r\n        Created,    // ÄÃ£ táº¡o Ä‘Æ¡n & khÃ³a tiá»n\r\n        Shipped,    // ÄÃ£ giao hÃ ng & á»©ng trÆ°á»›c 30%\r\n        Delivered,  // ÄÃ£ nháº­n hÃ ng\r\n        Completed,  // ÄÃ£ thanh toÃ¡n Ä‘á»§ 100%\r\n        Disputed    // Äang tranh cháº¥p\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    struct Order {\r\n        uint256 id;\r\n        address payable buyer;\r\n        address payable farmer;\r\n        address arbitrator;\r\n        string productName;\r\n        uint256 quantityKg;\r\n        uint256 totalAmount;\r\n        uint256 advancePaid;\r\n        OrderStatus status;\r\n        uint256 createdAt;\r\n        uint256 shippedAt;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    uint256 public orderCounter;\r\n    mapping(uint256 => Order) public orders;\r\n\r\n    event OrderCreated(\r\n        uint256 indexed orderId,\r\n        address indexed buyer,\r\n        address indexed farmer,\r\n        string productName,\r\n        uint256 totalAmount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event ShipmentConfirmed(\r\n        uint256 indexed orderId,\r\n        uint256 advanceAmount,\r\n        uint256 timestamp\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event DeliveryConfirmed(uint256 indexed orderId, uint256 timestamp);\r\n\r\n    event PaymentReleased(\r\n        uint256 indexed orderId,\r\n        address indexed farmer,\r\n        uint256 amount\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event DisputeRaised(\r\n        uint256 indexed orderId,\r\n        address indexed raisedBy,\r\n        string reason,\r\n        uint256 timestamp\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    event DisputeResolved(\r\n        uint256 indexed orderId,\r\n        address indexed arbitrator,\r\n        address indexed winner,\r\n        uint256 amount,\r\n        uint256 timestamp\r\n    );\r\n\r\n    modifier onlyBuyer(uint256 _orderId) {\r\n        require(msg.sender == orders[_orderId].buyer, \"Chi nguoi mua moi co quyen\");\r\n        _;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    modifier onlyFarmer(uint256 _orderId) {\r\n        require(msg.sender == orders[_orderId].farmer, \"Chi nong dan moi co quyen\");\r\n        _;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function createOrder(\r\n        address payable _farmer,\r\n        address _arbitrator,\r\n        string memory _productName,\r\n        uint256 _quantityKg\r\n    ) external payable returns (uint256) {\r\n        require(_farmer != address(0) && _farmer != msg.sender, \"Dia chi nong dan khong hop le\");\r\n        require(_arbitrator != address(0), \"Dia chi trong tai khong hop le\");\r\n        require(msg.value > 0, \"So tien khoa phai lon hon 0 AVAX\");\r\n        require(_quantityKg > 0, \"Khoi luong phai lon hon 0\");\r\n\r\n        orderCounter++;\r\n        uint256 newOrderId = orderCounter;\r\n\r\n        orders[newOrderId] = Order({\r\n            id: newOrderId,\r\n            buyer: payable(msg.sender),\r\n            farmer: _farmer,\r\n            arbitrator: _arbitrator,\r\n            productName: _productName,\r\n            quantityKg: _quantityKg,\r\n            totalAmount: msg.value,\r\n            advancePaid: 0,\r\n            status: OrderStatus.Created,\r\n            createdAt: block.timestamp,\r\n            shippedAt: 0\r\n        });\r\n\r\n        emit OrderCreated(newOrderId, msg.sender, _farmer, _productName, msg.value);\r\n        return newOrderId;\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function confirmShipment(uint256 _orderId) external onlyFarmer(_orderId) {\r\n        Order storage order = orders[_orderId];\r\n        require(order.status == OrderStatus.Created, \"Don hang khong o trang thai Created\");\r\n\r\n        uint256 advanceAmount = (order.totalAmount * 30) / 100;\r\n        \r\n        order.status = OrderStatus.Shipped;\r\n        order.advancePaid = advanceAmount;\r\n        order.shippedAt = block.timestamp;\r\n\r\n        (bool success, ) = order.farmer.call{value: advanceAmount}(\"\");\r\n        require(success, \"Giai ngan 30% that bai\");\r\n\r\n        emit ShipmentConfirmed(_orderId, advanceAmount, block.timestamp);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function confirmDelivery(uint256 _orderId) external onlyBuyer(_orderId) {\r\n        Order storage order = orders[_orderId];\r\n        require(order.status == OrderStatus.Shipped, \"Don hang chua o trang thai Shipped\");\r\n\r\n        uint256 remaining = order.totalAmount - order.advancePaid; // 70% con lai\r\n\r\n        // Cap nhat trang thai TRUOC khi chuyen tien\r\n        order.status = OrderStatus.Completed;\r\n\r\n        emit DeliveryConfirmed(_orderId, block.timestamp);\r\n\r\n        (bool success, ) = order.farmer.call{value: remaining}(\"\");\r\n        require(success, \"Giai ngan 70% that bai\");\r\n\r\n        emit PaymentReleased(_orderId, order.farmer, remaining);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n     function raiseDispute(uint256 _orderId, string calldata _reason) external {\r\n        require(_orderId > 0 && _orderId <= orderCounter, \"Don hang khong ton tai\");\r\n        Order storage order = orders[_orderId];\r\n\r\n        require(\r\n            msg.sender == order.buyer || msg.sender == order.farmer,\r\n            \"Chi nguoi mua hoac nong dan moi co quyen\"\r\n        );\r\n        require(order.status == OrderStatus.Shipped, \"Don hang chua o trang thai Shipped\");\r\n\r\n        order.status = OrderStatus.Disputed;\r\n\r\n        emit DisputeRaised(_orderId, msg.sender, _reason, block.timestamp);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function resolveDispute(uint256 _orderId, bool _favorFarmer) external {\r\n        require(_orderId > 0 && _orderId <= orderCounter, \"Don hang khong ton tai\");\r\n        Order storage order = orders[_orderId];\r\n\r\n        require(msg.sender == order.arbitrator, \"Chi trong tai moi co quyen\");\r\n        require(order.status == OrderStatus.Disputed, \"Don hang khong o trang thai Disputed\");\r\n\r\n        uint256 remaining = order.totalAmount - order.advancePaid; // 70% con lai\r\n        address payable winner = _favorFarmer ? order.farmer : order.buyer;\r\n\r\n        // Cap nhat trang thai TRUOC khi chuyen tien\r\n        order.status = OrderStatus.Completed;\r\n\r\n        (bool success, ) = winner.call{value: remaining}(\"\");\r\n        require(success, \"Chuyen tien that bai\");\r\n\r\n        emit DisputeResolved(_orderId, msg.sender, winner, remaining, block.timestamp);\r\n    }\r\n\r\n    function getOrder(uint256 _orderId) external view returns (Order memory) {\r\n        require(_orderId > 0 && _orderId <= orderCounter, \"Don hang khong ton tai\");\r\n        return orders[_orderId];\r\n    }\r\n}"
      }
    }
  }
}

// SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
pragma solidity ^0.8.20;

contract AgriEscrow {
    enum OrderStatus {
        Created,    // ÄÃ£ táº¡o Ä‘Æ¡n & khÃ³a tiá»n
        Shipped,    // ÄÃ£ giao hÃ ng & á»©ng trÆ°á»›c 30%
        Delivered,  // ÄÃ£ nháº­n hÃ ng
        Completed,  // ÄÃ£ thanh toÃ¡n Ä‘á»§ 100%
        Disputed    // Äang tranh cháº¥p
    }

    struct Order {
        uint256 id;
        address payable buyer;
        address payable farmer;
        address arbitrator;
        string productName;
        uint256 quantityKg;
        uint256 totalAmount;
        uint256 advancePaid;
        OrderStatus status;
        uint256 createdAt;
        uint256 shippedAt;
    }

    uint256 public orderCounter;
    mapping(uint256 => Order) public orders;

    event OrderCreated(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        address indexed buyer,
        address indexed farmer,
        string productName,
        uint256 totalAmount
    );

    event ShipmentConfirmed(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        uint256 advanceAmount,
        uint256 timestamp
    );

    event DeliveryConfirmed(uint256 indexed orderId, uint256 timestamp);

    event PaymentReleased(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        address indexed farmer,
        uint256 amount
    );

    event DisputeRaised(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        address indexed raisedBy,
        string reason,
        uint256 timestamp
    );

    event DisputeResolved(
        uint256 indexed orderId,
        address indexed arbitrator,
        address indexed winner,
        uint256 amount,
        uint256 timestamp
    );

    modifier onlyBuyer(uint256 _orderId) {
        require(msg.sender == orders[_orderId].buyer, "Chi nguoi mua moi co quyen");
        _;
    }

    modifier onlyFarmer(uint256 _orderId) {
        require(msg.sender == orders[_orderId].farmer, "Chi nong dan moi co quyen");
        _;
    }

    function createOrder(
        address payable _farmer,
        address _arbitrator,
        string memory _productName,
        uint256 _quantityKg
    ) external payable returns (uint256) {
        require(_farmer != address(0) && _farmer != msg.sender, "Dia chi nong dan khong hop le");
        require(_arbitrator != address(0), "Dia chi trong tai khong hop le");
        require(msg.value > 0, "So tien khoa phai lon hon 0 AVAX");
        require(_quantityKg > 0, "Khoi luong phai lon hon 0");

        orderCounter++;
        uint256 newOrderId = orderCounter;

        orders[newOrderId] = Order({
            id: newOrderId,
            buyer: payable(msg.sender),
            farmer: _farmer,
            arbitrator: _arbitrator,
            productName: _productName,
            quantityKg: _quantityKg,
            totalAmount: msg.value,
            advancePaid: 0,
            status: OrderStatus.Created,
            createdAt: block.timestamp,
            shippedAt: 0
        });

        emit OrderCreated(newOrderId, msg.sender, _farmer, _productName, msg.value);
        return newOrderId;
    }

    function confirmShipment(uint256 _orderId) external onlyFarmer(_orderId) {
        Order storage order = orders[_orderId];
        require(order.status == OrderStatus.Created, "Don hang khong o trang thai Created");

        uint256 advanceAmount = (order.totalAmount * 30) / 100;
        
        order.status = OrderStatus.Shipped;
        order.advancePaid = advanceAmount;
        order.shippedAt = block.timestamp;

        (bool success, ) = order.farmer.call{value: advanceAmount}("");
        require(success, "Giai ngan 30% that bai");

        emit ShipmentConfirmed(_orderId, advanceAmount, block.timestamp);
    }

    function confirmDelivery(uint256 _orderId) external onlyBuyer(_orderId) {
        Order storage order = orders[_orderId];
        require(order.status == OrderStatus.Shipped, "Don hang chua o trang thai Shipped");

        uint256 remaining = order.totalAmount - order.advancePaid; // 70% con lai

        // Cap nhat trang thai TRUOC khi chuyen tien
        order.status = OrderStatus.Completed;

        emit DeliveryConfirmed(_orderId, block.timestamp);

        (bool success, ) = order.farmer.call{value: remaining}("");
        require(success, "Giai ngan 70% that bai");

        emit PaymentReleased(_orderId, order.farmer, remaining);
    }

     function raiseDispute(uint256 _orderId, string calldata _reason) external {
        require(_orderId > 0 && _orderId <= orderCounter, "Don hang khong ton tai");
        Order storage order = orders[_orderId];

        require(
            msg.sender == order.buyer || msg.sender == order.farmer,
            "Chi nguoi mua hoac nong dan moi co quyen"
        );
        require(order.status == OrderStatus.Shipped, "Don hang chua o trang thai Shipped");

        order.status = OrderStatus.Disputed;

        emit DisputeRaised(_orderId, msg.sender, _reason, block.timestamp);
    }

    function resolveDispute(uint256 _orderId, bool _favorFarmer) external {
        require(_orderId > 0 && _orderId <= orderCounter, "Don hang khong ton tai");
        Order storage order = orders[_orderId];

        require(msg.sender == order.arbitrator, "Chi trong tai moi co quyen");
        require(order.status == OrderStatus.Disputed, "Don hang khong o trang thai Disputed");

        uint256 remaining = order.totalAmount - order.advancePaid; // 70% con lai
        address payable winner = _favorFarmer ? order.farmer : order.buyer;

        // Cap nhat trang thai TRUOC khi chuyen tien
        order.status = OrderStatus.Completed;

        (bool success, ) = winner.call{value: remaining}("");
        require(success, "Chuyen tien that bai");

        emit DisputeResolved(_orderId, msg.sender, winner, remaining, block.timestamp);
    }

    function getOrder(uint256 _orderId) external view returns (Order memory) {
        require(_orderId > 0 && _orderId <= orderCounter, "Don hang khong ton tai");
        return orders[_orderId];
    }
}

import { expect } from "chai";
import { network } from "hardhat";

describe("AgriEscrow - Pháº§n viá»‡c ThÃ nh viÃªn A", function () {
  it("1. Táº¡o Ä‘Æ¡n, khÃ³a 10 AVAX vÃ  tá»± Ä‘á»™ng giáº£i ngÃ¢n 30% (3 AVAX) khi giao hÃ ng", async function () {
    const { ethers } = await network.connect();
    const [buyer, farmer, arbitrator, stranger] = await ethers.getSigners();

    const escrow = await ethers.deployContract("AgriEscrow");
    const lockAmount = ethers.parseEther("10.0");

    // 1. NgÆ°á»i mua táº¡o Ä‘Æ¡n & khÃ³a 10 AVAX
    await escrow.connect(buyer).createOrder(
      farmer.address,
      arbitrator.address,
      "Sáº§u riÃªng Ri6",
      500,
      { value: lockAmount }
    );

    let order = await escrow.getOrder(1);
    expect(order.totalAmount).to.equal(lockAmount);
    expect(order.status).to.equal(0n); // Created

    // 2. Cháº·n ngÆ°á»i láº¡ xÃ¡c nháº­n giao hÃ ng
    await expect(
      escrow.connect(stranger).confirmShipment(1)
    ).to.be.revertedWith("Chi nong dan moi co quyen");

    // 3. NÃ´ng dÃ¢n xÃ¡c nháº­n giao -> nháº­n ngay 3 AVAX (30%)
    const farmerBalanceBefore = await ethers.provider.getBalance(farmer.address);
    const tx = await escrow.connect(farmer).confirmShipment(1);
    const receipt = await tx.wait();
    const gasUsed = receipt!.gasUsed * receipt!.gasPrice;
    const farmerBalanceAfter = await ethers.provider.getBalance(farmer.address);

    expect(farmerBalanceAfter - farmerBalanceBefore + gasUsed).to.equal(
      ethers.parseEther("3.0")
    );

    order = await escrow.getOrder(1);
    expect(order.status).to.equal(1n); // Shipped
    expect(order.advancePaid).to.equal(ethers.parseEther("3.0"));
  });
});

describe("AgriEscrow - confirmDelivery (ThÃ nh viÃªn B)", function () {
  async function setup() {
    const { ethers } = await network.connect();
    const [buyer, farmer, arbitrator, stranger] = await ethers.getSigners();
    const escrow = await ethers.deployContract("AgriEscrow");

    await escrow.connect(buyer).createOrder(
      farmer.address,
      arbitrator.address,
      "Sáº§u riÃªng Ri6",
      500,
      { value: ethers.parseEther("10.0") }
    );
    return { ethers, escrow, buyer, farmer, arbitrator, stranger };
  }

  it("2. NgÆ°á»i mua xÃ¡c nháº­n nháº­n hÃ ng -> nÃ´ng dÃ¢n nháº­n ná»‘t 7 AVAX, Ä‘Æ¡n Completed", async function () {
    const { ethers, escrow, buyer, farmer } = await setup();

    await escrow.connect(farmer).confirmShipment(1);

    const before = await ethers.provider.getBalance(farmer.address);
    await escrow.connect(buyer).confirmDelivery(1); // buyer tráº£ gas, farmer khÃ´ng máº¥t gas
    const after = await ethers.provider.getBalance(farmer.address);

    expect(after - before).to.equal(ethers.parseEther("7.0"));

import type {
  FunctionFragment,
  Typed,
  EventFragment,
  ContractTransaction,
  ContractTransactionResponse,
  DeferredTopicFilter,
  EventLog,
  TransactionRequest,
  LogDescription,
} from 'ethers'

export interface TypedDeferredTopicFilter<_TCEvent extends TypedContractEvent> extends DeferredTopicFilter {}

export interface TypedContractEvent<
  InputTuple extends Array<any> = any,
  OutputTuple extends Array<any> = any,
  OutputObject = any,
> {
  (...args: Partial<InputTuple>): TypedDeferredTopicFilter<TypedContractEvent<InputTuple, OutputTuple, OutputObject>>
  name: string
  fragment: EventFragment
  getFragment(...args: Partial<InputTuple>): EventFragment
}

type __TypechainAOutputTuple<T> = T extends TypedContractEvent<infer _U, infer W> ? W : never
type __TypechainOutputObject<T> = T extends TypedContractEvent<infer _U, infer _W, infer V> ? V : never

export interface TypedEventLog<TCEvent extends TypedContractEvent> extends Omit<EventLog, 'args'> {
  args: __TypechainAOutputTuple<TCEvent> & __TypechainOutputObject<TCEvent>
}

export interface TypedLogDescription<TCEvent extends TypedContractEvent> extends Omit<LogDescription, 'args'> {
  args: __TypechainAOutputTuple<TCEvent> & __TypechainOutputObject<TCEvent>
}

export type TypedListener<TCEvent extends TypedContractEvent> = (
  ...listenerArg: [...__TypechainAOutputTuple<TCEvent>, TypedEventLog<TCEvent>, ...undefined[]]
) => void

export type MinEthersFactory<C, ARGS> = {
  deploy(...a: ARGS[]): Promise<C>
}

export type GetContractTypeFromFactory<F> = F extends MinEthersFactory<infer C, any> ? C : never
export type GetARGsTypeFromFactory<F> = F extends MinEthersFactory<any, any> ? Parameters<F['deploy']> : never

export type StateMutability = 'nonpayable' | 'payable' | 'view'

export type BaseOverrides = Omit<TransactionRequest, 'to' | 'data'>
export type NonPayableOverrides = Omit<BaseOverrides, 'value' | 'blockTag' | 'enableCcipRead'>
export type PayableOverrides = Omit<BaseOverrides, 'blockTag' | 'enableCcipRead'>
export type ViewOverrides = Omit<TransactionRequest, 'to' | 'data'>
export type Overrides<S extends StateMutability> = S extends 'nonpayable'
  ? NonPayableOverrides
  : S extends 'payable'
  ? PayableOverrides
  : ViewOverrides

export type PostfixOverrides<A extends Array<any>, S extends StateMutability> = A | [...A, Overrides<S>]
export type ContractMethodArgs<A extends Array<any>, S extends StateMutability> = PostfixOverrides<
  { [I in keyof A]-?: A[I] | Typed },
  S
>

export type DefaultReturnType<R> = R extends Array<any> ? R[0] : R

// export interface ContractMethod<A extends Array<any> = Array<any>, R = any, D extends R | ContractTransactionResponse = R | ContractTransactionResponse> {
export interface TypedContractMethod<
  A extends Array<any> = Array<any>,
  R = any,
  S extends StateMutability = 'payable',
> {
  (...args: ContractMethodArgs<A, S>): S extends 'view'
    ? Promise<DefaultReturnType<R>>
    : Promise<ContractTransactionResponse>

  name: string

  fragment: FunctionFragment

  getFragment(...args: ContractMethodArgs<A, S>): FunctionFragment

  populateTransaction(...args: ContractMethodArgs<A, S>): Promise<ContractTransaction>
  staticCall(...args: ContractMethodArgs<A, 'view'>): Promise<DefaultReturnType<R>>
  send(...args: ContractMethodArgs<A, S>): Promise<ContractTransactionResponse>
  estimateGas(...args: ContractMethodArgs<A, S>): Promise<bigint>
  staticCallResult(...args: ContractMethodArgs<A, 'view'>): Promise<R>
}

const CONTRACT_ADDRESS = "0xYourDeployedContractAddressOnFuji";

export default function BuyerPortal() {

  const connectWallet = async () => {

    try {
      const provider = new ethers.BrowserProvider(window.ethereum);

      try {

          method: "wallet_switchEthereumChain",

      }

      setAccount(address);
      setContract(escrowContract);
      loadOrders(escrowContract);

  const loadOrders = async (escrowContract) => {
    try {
      const count = await escrowContract.orderCounter();
      const list = [];
      for (let i = Number(count); i >= 1; i--) {
        const o = await escrowContract.getOrder(i);
        list.push({
          id: Number(o.id),
          buyer: o.buyer,
          farmer: o.farmer,
          productName: o.productName,
          quantityKg: Number(o.quantityKg),
          totalAmount: ethers.formatEther(o.totalAmount),

    if (!contract) return alert("HÃ£y káº¿t ná»‘i vÃ­ trÆ°á»›c!");
    setLoading(true);
    setTxHash("");
    try {
      const tx = await contract.createOrder(
        form.farmerAddress,
        form.arbitratorAddress,
        form.productName,
        form.quantityKg,
        { value: ethers.parseEther(form.avaxAmount) }
      );
      setTxHash(tx.hash);
      await tx.wait();
      alert("Táº¡o Ä‘Æ¡n hÃ ng vÃ  khÃ³a tiá»n AVAX thÃ nh cÃ´ng!");
      setForm({ farmerAddress: "", arbitratorAddress: "", productName: "", quantityKg: "", avaxAmount: "" });

      alert("Giao dá»‹ch tháº¥t báº¡i: " + (err.reason || err.message));

    }
  };

  // 3. XÃ¡c nháº­n giao hÃ ng & Giáº£i ngÃ¢n 30% á»©ng trÆ°á»›c
  const handleConfirmShipment = async (orderId) => {
    if (!contract) return;

      loadOrders(contract);
    } catch (err) {
      alert("Lá»—i xÃ¡c nháº­n giao hÃ ng: " + (err.reason || err.message));
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  };

  return (
    <div style={{ maxWidth: "1000px", margin: "0 auto", padding: "24px", fontFamily: "sans-serif" }}>
      {/* Header & Káº¿t ná»‘i vÃ­ */}
      <header style={{ display: "flex", justifyContent: "space-between", alignItems: "center", borderBottom: "1px solid #ddd", paddingBottom: "16px" }}>
        <h2>AgriEscrow â€” Cá»•ng ÄÆ¡n HÃ ng & Thanh ToÃ¡n (Avalanche Fuji)</h2>
        <button onClick={connectWallet} style={{ padding: "10px 18px", background: "#E84142", color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: "8px", cursor: "pointer", fontWeight: "bold" }}>
          {account ? `VÃ­: ${account.slice(0, 6)}...${account.slice(-4)}` : "Káº¿t ná»‘i VÃ­ Avalanche"}
        </button>
      </header>

      {/* ThÃ´ng bÃ¡o Transaction Hash trÃªn Explorer */}
      {txHash && (
        <div style={{ background: "#f0fdf4", border: "1px solid #86efac", padding: "12px", borderRadius: "8px", marginTop: "16px" }}>
          <strong>Giao dá»‹ch Ä‘Ã£ gá»­i lÃªn Fuji Testnet:</strong>{" "}
          <a href={`https://testnet.snowtrace.io/tx/${txHash}`} target="_blank" rel="noreferrer">
            Xem trÃªn Avalanche Explorer ({txHash.slice(0, 12)}...)
          </a>
        </div>
      )}

      <div style={{ display: "grid", gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 1fr", gap: "24px", marginTop: "24px" }}>
        {/* Cá»™t trÃ¡i: Form táº¡o Ä‘Æ¡n hÃ ng */}
        <section style={{ border: "1px solid #e5e7eb", padding: "20px", borderRadius: "12px" }}>
          <h3>1. Táº¡o ÄÆ¡n HÃ ng & KhÃ³a Tiá»n</h3>
          <form onSubmit={handleCreateOrder} style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "12px" }}>
            <input placeholder="TÃªn nÃ´ng sáº£n (VD: Sáº§u riÃªng Ri6)" value={form.productName} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, productName: e.target.value })} required style={inputStyle} />
            <input type="number" placeholder="Khá»‘i lÆ°á»£ng (kg)" value={form.quantityKg} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, quantityKg: e.target.value })} required style={inputStyle} />
            <input placeholder="Äá»‹a chá»‰ vÃ­ NÃ´ng dÃ¢n (0x...)" value={form.farmerAddress} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, farmerAddress: e.target.value })} required style={inputStyle} />
            <input placeholder="Äá»‹a chá»‰ vÃ­ Trá»ng tÃ i (0x...)" value={form.arbitratorAddress} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, arbitratorAddress: e.target.value })} required style={inputStyle} />
            <input type="number" step="0.001" placeholder="Sá»‘ tiá»n khÃ³a Escrow (AVAX)" value={form.avaxAmount} onChange={(e) => setForm({ ...form, avaxAmount: e.target.value })} required style={inputStyle} />
            <button type="submit" disabled={loading} style={{ padding: "12px", background: "#16a34a", color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: "8px", fontWeight: "bold", cursor: "pointer" }}>
              {loading ? "Äang xá»­ lÃ½ Blockchain..." : "Táº¡o ÄÆ¡n & KhÃ³a AVAX"}
            </button>
          </form>
        </section>

        {/* Cá»™t pháº£i: Dashboard & Chi tiáº¿t Ä‘Æ¡n hÃ ng */}
        <section style={{ border: "1px solid #e5e7eb", padding: "20px", borderRadius: "12px" }}>
          <h3>2. Chi Tiáº¿t ÄÆ¡n HÃ ng & Giáº£i NgÃ¢n</h3>
          {selectedOrder ? (
            <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: "10px" }}>
              <div><strong>MÃ£ Ä‘Æ¡n:</strong> #{selectedOrder.id} â€” {selectedOrder.productName} ({selectedOrder.quantityKg} kg)</div>
              <div><strong>Tráº¡ng thÃ¡i:</strong> <span style={{ color: "#2563eb", fontWeight: "bold" }}>{STATUS_LABELS[selectedOrder.status]}</span></div>
              <div><strong>Tá»•ng tiá»n khÃ³a:</strong> {selectedOrder.totalAmount} AVAX</div>
              <div style={{ background: "#fefce8", padding: "12px", borderRadius: "8px", border: "1px solid #fde047" }}>
                <div><strong>Tiá»n á»©ng trÆ°á»›c (30%):</strong> {selectedOrder.advancePaid} AVAX {selectedOrder.status >= 1 ? "âœ… ÄÃ£ giáº£i ngÃ¢n" : "â³ Chá» giao hÃ ng"}</div>
                <div><strong>Tiá»n cÃ²n láº¡i (70%):</strong> {(Number(selectedOrder.totalAmount) * 0.7).toFixed(4)} AVAX (Giá»¯ trong Escrow)</div>
              </div>

              {selectedOrder.status === 0 && (
                <button
                  onClick={() => handleConfirmShipment(selectedOrder.id)}
                  disabled={loading}
                  style={{ marginTop: "8px", padding: "10px", background: "#2563eb", color: "#fff", border: "none", borderRadius: "8px", fontWeight: "bold", cursor: "pointer" }}
                >
                  XÃ¡c Nháº­n ÄÃ£ Giao HÃ ng (Giáº£i NgÃ¢n 30%)
                </button>
              )}
            </div>
          ) : (
            <p>ChÆ°a cÃ³ Ä‘Æ¡n hÃ ng nÃ o. HÃ£y káº¿t ná»‘i vÃ­ hoáº·c táº¡o Ä‘Æ¡n má»›i.</p>
          )}

          {/* Danh sÃ¡ch chá»n nhanh Ä‘Æ¡n hÃ ng */}
          <h4 style={{ marginTop: "20px", borderTop: "1px solid #eee", paddingTop: "12px" }}>Danh sÃ¡ch Ä‘Æ¡n ({orders.length})</h4>
          <ul style={{ listStyle: "none", padding: 0 }}>
            {orders.map((o) => (
              <li
                key={o.id}
                onClick={() => setSelectedOrder(o)}
                style={{ padding: "8px", borderBottom: "1px solid #f3f4f6", cursor: "pointer", background: selectedOrder?.id === o.id ? "#eff6ff" : "transparent" }}
              >
                <strong>#{o.id}</strong> - {o.productName} ({o.totalAmount} AVAX) â€” <em>{STATUS_LABELS[o.status]}</em>
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        </section>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

:root {
  --text: #6b6375;

  --accent-bg: rgba(170, 59, 255, 0.1);
  --accent-border: rgba(170, 59, 255, 0.5);
  --social-bg: rgba(244, 243, 236, 0.5);
  --shadow:
    rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1) 0 10px 15px -3px, rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.05) 0 4px 6px -2px;

  --sans: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
  --heading: system-ui, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif;
  --mono: ui-monospace, Consolas, monospace;

  font: 18px/145% var(--sans);

  color: var(--text);
